title: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-11-19 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST…
description: DreameHome cloud API versions before 2026-11-19 have an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/bindDevice endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users to reassign ownership of another user's camera to their own account by supplying the camera identifiers and their own user identity. As a result, the attacker becomes the camera's master user and removes the camera from the legitimate owner's device list, denying the owner access through DreameHome.
